parts.name: AutocompleteRoot
parts.description: Holds the input's text and the open state, and shares them with the parts inside it through Combobox's `combobox` context.

props.name: value
props.description: The input's text. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control it.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The input's text at first, when `value` isn't controlled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the input's new text: what was typed, or a suggestion's label once chosen. An inline preview isn't reported until it is chosen.

props.name: mode
props.description: How the input completes what is typed: `"list"` filters the suggestions; `"inline"` shows the highlighted suggestion in the input; `"both"` does both; `"none"` neither. It is also the input's `aria-autocomplete`.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the popup is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the popup is open at first, when `open` isn't controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called after the popup opened or closed, whatever closed it.

props.name: filter
props.description: Whether a suggestion labelled `label` matches what was typed.

props.name: autoHighlight
props.description: Highlight the first matching suggestion as the user types.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether the arrow keys go from the last suggestion back to the input, and on to the first.

props.name: openOnInputClick
props.description: Whether a click in the input opens the list.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the autocomplete is disabled. Also disabled inside a disabled `FieldRoot`.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the text can't be changed. The popup doesn't open.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the input must have text for the form to submit. Validated by an enclosing `FieldRoot`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the suggestions are being fetched: pass `pending? results` (and `results == null` before the first answer) for `results = await search(value)`. `AutocompleteEmpty` stays empty, the list is `aria-busy`, and the popup and list carry `data-loading`.

parts.name: InputGroup
parts.description: Import from `./ui/glaze/input-group.rx`. Place the input and its optional trigger or clear button directly inside this group. It keeps the actions inside the field and aligns the popup with the full input width.

parts.name: AutocompleteInput
parts.description: The text input, with `role="combobox"`. Its text is the value: give it a `name` to submit it with a form. Typing opens the popup; the arrow keys move the highlight while focus stays here; Enter chooses the highlighted suggestion.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field's value has changed.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the autocomplete is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field has a value.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the popup is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the autocomplete is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when text is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field has been focused and left.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is valid.

parts.name: AutocompleteTrigger
parts.description: A primary mouse press opens the popup and focuses the input. Release outside the trigger to cancel the opening. A completed tap or virtual click toggles it. The trigger isn't a Tab stop. Give it an `aria-label`.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the autocomplete is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the popup is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the autocomplete is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when text is required.

parts.name: AutocompleteClear
parts.description: A button that empties the input and focuses it. It is rendered only while the input has text, and isn't a Tab stop. Give it an `aria-label`.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Whether to render the button while the input is empty. Default: false.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the autocomplete is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the popup is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the autocomplete is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when text is required.

parts.name: AutocompleteValue
parts.description: The input's text, shown somewhere else, or the placeholder while it is empty.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the input is empty (the part then carries `data-placeholder`).

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the autocomplete is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-placeholder
dataAttributes.description: Present while the input is empty and the placeholder is shown.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the popup is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the autocomplete is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when text is required.

parts.name: AutocompletePopup
parts.description: The popup: an element with `popover="manual"`, placed against the input with CSS anchor positioning and at least as wide as it. Style it with `:popover-open` and `@starting-style`. A press inside it keeps focus in the input.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the input it sits on; the browser flips it when it doesn't fit. Default: `"bottom"`.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the input it lines up with. Default: `"start"`.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between input and popup, in pixels.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: How far the popup is moved along the input's edge from its `align` position, in pixels. Default: 0.

dataAttributes.name: data-empty
dataAttributes.description: Present while no suggestion matches what was typed.

dataAttributes.name: data-loading
dataAttributes.description: Present while the root's `loading` is true.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of the input the popup is on: the one asked for, then the one the browser placed it on.

parts.name: AutocompleteList
parts.description: The listbox that holds the suggestions. The input's `aria-controls` points at it.

dataAttributes.name: data-empty
dataAttributes.description: Present while no suggestion matches what was typed.

dataAttributes.name: data-loading
dataAttributes.description: Present while the root's `loading` is true; the list is `aria-busy` then too.

parts.name: AutocompleteItem
parts.description: A suggestion. Choosing it fills the input with its label and closes the popup. It isn't rendered while it doesn't match what was typed (modes `"list"` and `"both"`).

props.name: value
props.description: Identifies the suggestion. The input is filled with its label, not this.

props.name: label
props.description: The text the filter matches and the input is filled with. Default: the suggestion's text.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the suggestion can't be highlighted or chosen.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-highlighted
dataAttributes.description: Present while the suggestion is highlighted: the input's `aria-activedescendant`.

dataAttributes.name: data-label
dataAttributes.description: The suggestion's label.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Never present on a suggestion: an autocomplete has no selection.

dataAttributes.name: data-value
dataAttributes.description: The suggestion's `value`.

parts.name: AutocompleteGroup
parts.description: Groups related suggestions under an `AutocompleteGroupLabel`. It gets `hidden` while none of its suggestions match.

parts.name: AutocompleteGroupLabel
parts.description: The heading of a group. The group's `aria-labelledby` points at it.

parts.name: AutocompleteEmpty
parts.description: A `role="status"` element whose children show while no suggestion is rendered, except while the root is `loading`. The element stays in the document, empty, otherwise.

parts.name: AutocompleteStatus
parts.description: A `role="status"` element with `aria-live="polite"`, for a message about the list, such as a result count.

parts.name: AutocompleteSeparator
parts.description: A horizontal `role="separator"` between suggestions or groups.

parts.name: AutocompleteArrow
parts.description: An element placed on the popup's edge that faces the input, centred on it. It follows the popup when the browser flips it. Give it a shape in CSS and turn it per `data-side`.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of the input the popup is on. Absent until the popup first opens; a close keeps the last side.
